newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Poland says it ready for NATO, EU membership.
newsitem.headline: Poland says it ready for NATO, EU membership.

text.p: Poland's Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz said on Thursday his country had already fulfilled all the necessary criteria for membership of the European Union, NATO and the Western European Union (WEU).
"We intend to join them as soon as we will have such a possibility... for some of us NATO membership will come first," he said in a speech delivered to the WEU, the EU's fledgling defence wing.
Poland is one of the leading candidates of countries expected to be invited to join the alliance at a special summit in Madrid next July.
On Friday, Cimoszewicz will push his country's case for membership at meeting with NATO and EU officials.
